tolerance.basis: ITTC-1957 line is an empirical fit to flat-plate data; 0.5% band is the reading accuracy claimed for model-scale Cf

source.doc: ITTC 1957 frictional resistance line (8th ITTC, Madrid, 1957); reproduced in ITTC Recommended Procedure 7.5-02-03-01.4 '1978 ITTC Performance Prediction Method'
source.access_note: formula transcribed from the ITTC recommended procedure text; page/table numbers not re-verified against a primary PDF because no scan is held in-repo (offline discipline)

sha256_scope: sha256 over the archived digitisation artefact (sources/ittc1957.cf_friction_line.csv), i.e. the byte-exact table this entry serves; no page image of the source document is held in-repo, so the anchor does not claim pixel-level provenance

digitisation_error.note: print rounding of pass B (5 s.f.) dominates; the closed form itself is reproduced at machine precision

validity_range.note: 1e5 <= Re <= 1e9: the Reynolds range over which the ITTC-1957 line is used for model/ship extrapolation

dual_pass.note: pass A = machine-precision transcription of the published closed form; pass B = re-typed at printed precision (5-6 s.f.) with an independent format convention. Human double-keying is NOT claimed.

notes: Cf is monotone decreasing in Re; served by monotone PCHIP so no overshoot can create a negative friction coefficient.
Cross-checked against the independent implementation in delivered node W8-N07 (mission 1218): Cf(Re=1e9) matches to 0 ulp.
